day2_after_start.text: *The last class ends and Eunsu approaches.*

day2_after_eunsu_1.text: Our school handles almost everything through one app. Wi-Fi, library entry, even the cafeteria QR code.

day2_after_eunsu_2.text: This is the last step of your transfer registration. If you don't install it, the cafeteria QR won't scan for you starting tomorrow.

day2_after_eunsu_3.text: *I search the app store. 'Hanul Smart Campus'. 4.8 stars. High rating.*

day2_after_eunsu_5.text: Here's your student number. The same number was on your desk, too.

day2_after_eunsu_6.text: *The teacher handed me a sticky note. A small check mark was already drawn beneath the six digits.*

day2_after_eunsu_7.text:
*When I launched the app, permission requests appeared one after another.

[Location] Campus emergency location check
[Camera] Student ID QR
[Microphone] Emergency call*

day2_after_eunsu_8.text: *The permissions request window didn't fit on one screen. A gray scroll bar still remained at the bottom.*

choices: Change location to 'Only while using the app'

day2_after_limit_1.text: *App notification: 'Location permission is restricted. Emergency safety features will be disabled.'*

day2_after_limit_2.text: Location permission defaults to 'Always Allow.' It causes fewer errors inside the school.

day2_after_limit_4.text: The policy changed after last year. The notification wording was added then, too.

day2_after_limit_5.text: *The gray toggle on the settings screen turned blue. The app's `Safety Status` indicator at the bottom immediately turned green.*

day2_after_sea_1.text: You came? Thanks for coming again today.

day2_after_sea_4.text: *Sea smiles. The hand she had been clenching under the desk loosens a little.*

day2_after_sea_5.text: *Stacks of documents on the student council room desk. Sports day paperwork.*

day2_after_sea_6.text: Sports day is next week. I need to organize the event programs and class applications.

day2_after_sea_8.text: Is that so? Could you sort the applications by date?

day2_after_sea_9.text: *Sea organized the event programs, and I sorted the application forms. The sound of turning pages continued steadily between us.*

day2_after_sea_10.text: Look, Class 2 signed up for both tug-of-war and relay. Ambitious.

day2_after_sea_12.text: Our class... still hasn't turned theirs in. I need to collect them by tomorrow morning.

day2_after_sea_13.text: You can just collect them tomorrow.

day2_after_sea_14.text: I was supposed to collect at least half by the end of today.

day2_after_sea_15.text:
*Sea drops the application form on the desk with a thud.*

*After working for a while, Sea plays music. The same band from lunch.*

day2_after_sea_17.text: *The sound of papers and music. Sunset light pours in through the window. Dust drifts slowly above the desk.*

day2_after_sea_18.text: ...{name}. Can I pull out one more chair here?

day2_after_sea_19.text: Wasn't there a spare chair here?

day2_after_sea_20.text: *Sea looks out the window. The sunset colors her face. On the edge of the desk, only one cup ring has been left there for a long time.*

day2_after_sea_21.text: There was, but no one ever sat there for long.

day2_after_sea_22.text: *Sea tries to smile, but crumples the corner of the paper.*

day2_after_sea_23.text: ...Then should we do this here tomorrow, too?

day2_after_sea_24.text: ...Yeah. I'll put your name on it. We can't let the applications get mixed up.

day2_after_sea_26.text: *Sea starts writing my name on the label, then rewrites the letters a little smaller.*

day2_after_sea_27.text: ...I'll make sure it doesn't come off.

day2_after_sea_28.text: *After that, we worked without a word. The music was one notch lower than before.*

day2_after_hallway_1.text: *Leaving the student council room, I walk down the hallway and find some classmates gathered by the vending machine.*

day2_after_hallway_2.text: Oh, {name}! What are you doing here?

day2_after_hallway_3.text: I was helping Sea in the student council room.

day2_after_hallway_4.text: Helping Sea? Already? You've only been here two days.

day2_after_hallway_5.text: Once the class president starts being nice to you, there's no escape.

day2_after_hallway_7.text: Hey, want something from the vending machine? I'll buy you one.

day2_after_hallway_9.text: Come on, we should at least do this much for the new kid. A welcome gesture.

day2_after_hallway_10.text:
*I took the can of coffee milk. It was cold.

We chatted for a while. Places to eat near school, class names for sports day, how quickly our homeroom teacher graded things.*

day2_after_hallway_11.text: *I rolled the can in my hand. Cold coffee milk. The same flavor as the one I got yesterday.*

day2_after_seolhwa_1.text:
*I'm about to walk out the school gate when I feel a gaze from behind.*

*I stop and turn around.*

day2_after_seolhwa_2.text: *It's Seolhwa. Standing inside the gate, watching me. In the sunset light. Her long hair drifts in the wind over her uniform.*

day2_after_seolhwa_3.text: *...Even after I blink once, she's still there. Looking at me. Sunset light gathers around her eyes.*

day2_after_seolhwa_4.text: *Her lips move. I can't hear a sound. Even though the wind is blowing toward me.*

day2_after_seolhwa_5.text: *My throat goes dry. I take one step toward Seolhwa.*

day2_after_seolhwa_6.text: *A group of students passes by. My view is blocked. One second. When I look again, Seolhwa is already walking away.*

day2_after_seolhwa_7.text: *Her retreating figure disappears into the schoolyard. Slipping between students, but no one says hello.*

day2_after_seolhwa_8.text:
*Between the students' shoulders, I remembered where Seolhwa's empty desk was.

Tomorrow, I'll look back before the bell rings.*
